strangulationMigrationPlan.rationale: Public-facing civic issues, comments, disputes, and content reports must be moderated and rate-limited at the API gateway.

strangulationMigrationPlan.phase: Phase 2: Social Feed, Reactions & Poll Voting
strangulationMigrationPlan.rationale: Prevent vote stuffing, malicious post injections, and unmoderated comments by centralizing write validation in Fastify.
Sensitive identity data (KYC, biometric selfies, forensic device fingerprints) must never be written directly from client without strict server-side schema verification and encryption.

strangulationMigrationPlan.phase: Phase 4: Political Shorts & Aspirant Leadership Academy
strangulationMigrationPlan.rationale: Video shorts uploads, endorsements, and leadership academy quiz grading.
